    • stagedInsertionIsInvisibleUntilCommit

      @GameTest(structure="somestacks:somestacks_empty", maxTicks=100) public void stagedInsertionIsInvisibleUntilCommit(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      No in-game reproduction applies: Fabric automation stages an insertion without publishing it to the block entity, then publishes the complete edit when the transaction commits.

    • wholeStorageInsertExtractAndNestedRollbackAreAtomic

    • storageUtilMovesItemsFromChestIntoRun

      @GameTest(structure="somestacks:somestacks_empty", maxTicks=100) public void storageUtilMovesItemsFromChestIntoRun(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: connect Fabric Transfer API automation between a chest and a SomeStacks run; moving an item removes it from the chest and inserts it into the run.

    • transactionAllowsOnlyOneStructuralExtractionPosition

      @GameTest(structure="somestacks:somestacks_empty", maxTicks=100) public void transactionAllowsOnlyOneStructuralExtractionPosition(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)

    • headroomRollbackRestoresWaterAndCommitGrowsEachType

      @GameTest(structure="somestacks:somestacks_empty", maxTicks=100) public void headroomRollbackRestoresWaterAndCommitGrowsEachType(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: pump into the headroom of each stack type in water. A successful transfer grows a waterlogged block; an aborted machine transfer leaves the water intact.

    • stagedSupportFillsCellsAndHeadroomBottomUp

      @GameTest(structure="somestacks:somestacks_empty", maxTicks=100) public void stagedSupportFillsCellsAndHeadroomBottomUp(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: fill Singles and Bar columns through automation. One transfer can fill supporting cells and then insert above them, including across the new block's seam.
